devotions: Garden Rosary: First Saturday after the 17:30 Mass.
Grotto Rosary: Every 13th of the month after the 18:30 Mass (weekdays only).
Blessing of Expectant Mothers: Every Fourth Sunday of the month.

events.title: Columbaria Visits
events.text: As part of the Month of praying for the dead in November, the parish is organising visits to columbaria in other parishes on 14 & 28 November 2026, from 9am - 12.30pm. Transport via chartered bus is provided. Places are limited. For more information and to register, please go to: https://tinyurl.com
